items.rationale: The code GB-610 is found, so the if_not_found argument is never used. The error comes from dividing by zero in a later step, and only IFERROR wraps that step and replaces any error.

The fourth argument makes the lookup return the text Not listed. Multiplying text by 2 is not possible, so the result is #VALUE!. The text only helps when you do not use the result in arithmetic, otherwise wrap the formula in IFERROR.
Sell-through is units sold divided by opening stock, and 36 / 48 = 0.75, which is 75% of the stock sold.

IFERROR replaces every kind of error with the same message, so a broken formula looks the same as an expected gap. Use it on calculations where you know the failure is expected, such as a division by a possible zero.
